content.short: Proxy is a multi-chain trading protocol offering cross-chain derivatives.
content.description: Proxy takes a multichain approach to DeFi, weaving together ecosystems like Polkadot, Ethereum, and Cosmos to broaden the range of assets available for trading and lending. By using cross‑chain derivatives, users gain access to a wider set of opportunities across competing networks. The amount you can borrow depends on the Proxi tokens you hold, with a potential limit of up to 200% of any token, to be repaid later. This multichain framework aims to unlock smoother liquidity and broader exposure to assets across networks.
